slides.title: A page on your computer
slides.html: The ODMDM connector runs on the MDM operator's computer and opens as a page in the browser. It talks to your MDM with your token, never to Deploy App.

slides.title: Open a terminal
slides.html: Installing takes a few typed lines. On Windows, open Start, type PowerShell and press Enter. On a Mac, press Cmd+Space, type Terminal and press Enter.

slides.title: Get uv and git
slides.html: The connector installs with uv, which fetches it with git. Type the lines for your computer, pressing Enter after each and accepting what the Mac offers to install, then close the terminal and open a new one.

slides.title: Install it
slides.html: Type this as one line and press Enter: uv tool install git+https://github.com/pvarki/python-odmdm-fleet

slides.title: Start it
slides.html: Type odmdm-connector web and press Enter: the connector's page opens in your browser. If it does not open, open the address the terminal shows.

slides.title: Your default browser
slides.html: It opens in your default browser: use Deploy App in that same browser. Start it only once: if it says the connector may be running already, use the page you have.

slides.title: Keep the terminal open
slides.html: The connector runs while its terminal is open, and Ctrl+C stops it. A page whose connector has stopped says so.

slides.title: A new address at every start
slides.html: Every start makes a new address, and a page left open from before asks for it. Start the connector again and use the page it opens.

slides.title: What it keeps
slides.html: With Remember on this computer ticked, your token goes to the computer's keychain, never to a file. The challenge is held only while the connector runs.

slides.title: No internet?
slides.html: For a network without internet, technical staff can carry the connector in as one file: see its README. It needs only Python 3.11 or newer, and asks for the token at each start.

slides.title: Upgrade it
slides.html: Stop the connector with Ctrl+C and type the install line again with --reinstall at the end. If you use a plugin, keep its --with part in the line.

slides.title: Before removing it
slides.html: Open the Deploy App's name at the top right and remove each Deploy App. The connector then forgets its token, and the keychain keeps nothing.

slides.title: Remove it
slides.html: Stop the connector, then type uv tool uninstall odmdm-connector in a terminal.
